Initial release: TypeScript "any" sprawl auditor and type-coverage enforcer.

- Scans your codebase for explicit and implicit uses of `any`, as well as `@ts-ignore` and `@ts-expect-error` suppressions.
- Audits your `tsconfig.json` for weak or missing type-safety settings.
- Reports a type-coverage percentage score (powered by the `type-coverage` npm package).
- Ranks files by `any` density to help prioritize fixes.
- Generates a `.type-coverage` budget file for CI enforcement.
- Works on any TypeScript project with zero setup and no required config changes.
